subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in Spanish on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (Spanish↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: What does 'el ocio' mean?
questions.explain: 'El ocio' means 'leisure / free time'; it is a false friend with English 'office' (which is 'la oficina').

questions.q: How do you say 'I like playing the guitar'?
questions.explain: Instruments use 'tocar' (not 'jugar'); 'me gusta' + infinitive, so 'Me gusta tocar la guitarra'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I went to the cinema yesterday'?
options: Ayer iba al cine a menudo
questions.explain: 'Fui' is the preterite of 'ir' (I went); with 'ayer' the completed past is correct: 'Ayer fui al cine'.

questions.q: What does 'soy aficionado al baloncesto' mean?
options: I am a fan of basketball
questions.explain: 'Ser aficionado a' means 'to be a fan of', so this means 'I am a fan of basketball'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I prefer reading to watching TV'?
options: Prefiero leer a ver la televisión
Prefiero ver la televisión a leer
Prefiero leyendo a ver la televisión
Prefieres leer a ver la televisión
questions.explain: 'Preferir A a B' uses infinitives: 'Prefiero leer a ver la televisión' = 'I prefer reading to watching TV'.

questions.q: What does 'descargar música' mean?
questions.explain: 'Descargar' means 'to download', so 'descargar música' = 'to download music'.

questions.q: What is celebrated in Spain on 'el Día de los Reyes Magos' (6 January)?
options: The Three Kings / Epiphany, when children get presents
questions.explain: 'Los Reyes Magos' are the Three Kings; on 6 January Spanish children traditionally receive their presents.

questions.q: What does 'los fuegos artificiales' mean?
questions.explain: 'Los fuegos artificiales' literally 'artificial fires' means 'fireworks'.

questions.q: How do you say 'We celebrate my grandmother's birthday'?
options: Celebramos el cumpleaños de mi abuela
Celebramos el cumpleaños de mi abuelo
Celebro el cumpleaños de mi abuela
Celebramos la Navidad de mi abuela
questions.explain: 'Celebramos' = 'we celebrate' and 'de mi abuela' = 'my grandmother's', so the first option is correct.

questions.q: What does 'la Nochebuena' mean?
questions.explain: 'La Nochebuena' (24 December) means 'Christmas Eve'; 'la Nochevieja' is New Year's Eve.

questions.q: What is 'La Tomatina', held in Buñol?
options: A festival where people throw tomatoes
questions.explain: 'La Tomatina' is a famous Spanish festival in which participants throw tomatoes at each other.

questions.q: How do you say 'It is a tradition to eat twelve grapes'?
options: Es una tradición comer doce uvas
Es una tradición comer doce huevos
Está una tradición comer doce uvas
Es una tradición comiendo doce uvas
questions.explain: 'Es una tradición' + infinitive: 'comer doce uvas' = 'to eat twelve grapes' (a Spanish New Year custom).

questions.q: What does 'el éxito' mean?
questions.explain: 'El éxito' is a false friend: it means 'success', not 'exit' (which is 'la salida').

questions.q: How do you say 'My favourite singer is very famous'?
options: Mi cantante favorito es muy famoso
Mi cantante favorito está muy famoso
Mi cantante favorita es muy famoso
Mi cantante favorito es muy hambriento
questions.explain: 'Es' is used for permanent fame, and 'favorito/famoso' agree as masculine: 'Mi cantante favorito es muy famoso'.

questions.q: What does 'una estrella de cine' mean?
questions.explain: 'Una estrella de cine' literally 'a star of cinema' means 'a film star'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Famous people influence young people'?
options: Los famosos influyen en los jóvenes
Los famosos influyen en los ancianos
Los jóvenes influyen en los famosos
questions.explain: 'Influir en' = 'to influence', and 'los jóvenes' = 'young people', so the first option is correct.

questions.q: What does 'seguir a un influencer en las redes sociales' mean?
options: To follow an influencer on social media
questions.explain: 'Seguir' means 'to follow', so this means 'to follow an influencer on social media'.

questions.q: How would you write 'divertido' to describe two films ('películas')?
questions.explain: 'Película' is feminine, so the plural adjective is feminine plural: 'divertidas'.

questions.q: Which means 'I used to play football every weekend' (habitual past)?
options: Jugaba al fútbol todos los fines de semana
Jugué al fútbol todos los fines de semana
Juego al fútbol todos los fines de semana
Jugaré al fútbol todos los fines de semana
questions.explain: Habitual past actions use the imperfect: 'jugaba' = 'I used to play'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'This weekend I am going to go to a concert' (near future)?
options: Este fin de semana voy a ir a un concierto
Este fin de semana fui a un concierto
Este fin de semana iba a un concierto
Este fin de semana voy a un concierto ayer
questions.explain: The near future uses 'ir a' + infinitive: 'voy a ir' = 'I am going to go'.
